title: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Treatment (PDQ) - Patient Version
author: National Cancer Institute
support: Identifies adenocarcinoma as an NSCLC histology and describes persistent cough and difficulty breathing. Symptoms are clinical context for NSCLC, not a frequency estimate specific to this LUAD cohort.

title: Small Cell Lung Cancer Treatment (PDQ) - Patient Version
author: National Cancer Institute
support: Describes persistent cough and difficulty breathing as SCLC symptoms and lists topotecan among chemotherapy options.

title: Tagrisso (osimertinib) tablets: Prescribing information
author: U.S. Food and Drug Administration
support: Sections 1 and 12.1 support approved uses in specified EGFR-mutant NSCLC populations and inhibition of mutant EGFR, including L858R. This supports contextual EGFR biology and a drug-target edge, not treatment eligibility for every LUAD case. Label revision September 2024; not represented as the latest label.

title: Topotecan injection: Prescribing information
author: U.S. Food and Drug Administration
support: Section 1 documents an SCLC indication in platinum-sensitive disease after progression; section 12.1 describes trapping of the topoisomerase I-DNA complex. TOP1-to-SCLC is therapeutic-target context, not a claim that TOP1 is an SCLC driver. No LUAD efficacy is established by this path. Label revision December 2019; not represented as the latest label.

title: Extracellular matrix organization (R-HSA-1474244)
author: Reactome
support: Curated human pathway. Human physical-entity pages verify membership of COL6A6, COL11A1, TNXB, and TNR. General matrix remodeling biology supports a hypothesis about tissue composition or stromal biology, not a validated LUAD subtype.

title: Lectin pathway of complement activation (R-HSA-166662)
author: Reactome
support: Human pathway summary directly describes MASP1 involvement in protease activation and complement signaling. This is pathway membership, not evidence that MASP1 causes LUAD.

title: Signaling by EGFR (R-HSA-177929)
author: Reactome
support: Curated human receptor signaling pathway with EGFR as the receptor. EGFR belongs to contextual drug-target biology, not the ranked top-15 LUAD candidates.

title: Cough (HP:0012735)
author: Human Phenotype Ontology Consortium
support: Identifier and label verified directly in the official HPO ontology on the retrieval date. HPO standardizes the phenotype term; NCI supplies disease-to-symptom evidence.

title: Dyspnea (HP:0002094)
author: Human Phenotype Ontology Consortium
support: Identifier and label verified directly in the official HPO ontology on the retrieval date. NCI descriptions of breathing difficulty are harmonized to this term; no symptom frequency is inferred.

title: NM_005228.5(EGFR):c.2573T>G (p.Leu858Arg), Variation ID 16609
author: National Center for Biotechnology Information
support: Verifies EGFR L858R, transcript NM_005228.5:c.2573T>G, variant identifier 16609 and gene association. The LUAD record documents the disease context. This is an external contextual variant; it is not asserted to occur in this project cohort. Aggregate germline, drug-response, clinical-impact and somatic-oncogenicity classifications must not be conflated.

title: HGNC gene symbol reports and REST API
author: HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee
support: Official symbol-specific records retrieved directly for the 15 ranked candidates plus EGFR and TOP1. All 17 returned one record with approved symbol, HGNC, Ensembl, NCBI Gene and UniProt identifiers.
